chrome_hint: eBay AU sold listings (Terapeak): 'bakelite mantel radio dual wave', 'model 510M radio', 'bakelite shortwave mantel radio Australian valve', 'Astor OR Kriesler OR Healing OR Bandmaster 510M'. Also Google 'Australian radio model 510M valve' and the Radio Heritage / Australian Wireless Valve Radio Info (Kevin Chant) model lists to name the maker. Check Leski Auctions realised prices for 'bakelite mantel radio'.
viewing_check: Read the maker name from the green paper label and model/serial on the chassis (remove back if allowed), and the dial or cabinet badge. Check for cabinet cracks and chips, dial glass, knobs (all three), and rust on the transformer. Maker name decides value: Astor, Healing or AWA Radiolette styles can be worth much more than generic.
rate_note: All hits are in AUD, no conversion needed.
